messages:
Maya: FYI — peer-feedback embargo window opens tomorrow 09:00 PT. Managers: please flag any reviewers on LOA before then so we can redistribute workload.

Samir: Quick q — what's the request flow for LOA-related extensions?

Maya: Short answer: fill the form linked below OR DM me if it's urgent. We offer a manager +48h extension for documented LOA/caregiver reasons. Form: https://redwoodinference.internal/peopleops/feedback-extensions

Eli: How aggressive is the auto-redistribution? Last cycle a couple reviewers got dumped a ton of handbacks mid-week. :grimacing:

ops-bot: Auto-redistribution policy v2.1: if reviewer pending_handbacks > 28 AND avg_response_time > 72h, system reassigns up to 6 pending handbacks to the next eligible reviewer pool. Eligibility checks: same seniority band, no current LOA, <18 pending handbacks.

Kara: Does redistribution impact calibration assignments? I worry about skewing the calibration sample.

Maya: Good call — calibration sample is frozen 24h before cycle close. Any reassigned peer-feedback after freeze will NOT be part of calibration buckets. We surface a note in the calibration UI when reassignment happens.

Samir: If I request a +48h extension for a reviewer, will their assigned items get reassigned automatically?

Maya: No — extensions pause the reassign logic for that reviewer for the extension window. If you want reassignment instead, choose "reassign now" on the form.

Eli: Can leads do batch reassignment? For big teams it's painful to click each one.

Maya: Yes — we accept a CSV upload at the reassign endpoint. Minimal format: `reviewer_from,reviewer_to,feedback_id` Example: 
```
samir,eli,98123
samir,eli,98124
```
Upload link is on the same form page.

Kara: Are there guardrails so we don't overload the same reviewer by design?

ops-bot: Guardrail: post-reassign, recipient reviewer pending_handbacks <= 26 (soft limit). If assignment would push them above, system suggests alternate recipients.

Samir: Also — weekend drop-ins: can we schedule an ops person to cover handbacks on Sat/Sun? Some managers want a weekend buffer.

Maya: We can run a limited weekend coverage rota for the final 3 days of the cycle. Need volunteers — if you're ok to be on-call for a 4-hour block, add your name to this spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/feedback-weekend-rota 

Eli: Suggestion: add a slack badge on reviewer profile showing current pending_handbacks so managers can see load without asking.

Maya: Love this — filing a product request. For now you can query `/reviewer-status @handle` and the bot returns pending count and avg turnaround.

Samir: Thanks — doing the LOA form now. Tagging @Maya if any followups. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Request received. Ticket #FB-2401 created and assigned to Maya. You will get an email confirmation within 15 minutes. :white_check_mark:
